takes place on a floodplain area, surrounded by two large cliffs and a lake. Along the path are multiple road cones, barriers and blue, green and red shipping containers. There is also a black car, two police cars and an advertisement billboard along the side of the road. The road bridges over two canals, which are filled with trash bags and empty boxes. There are also various trees and rocks scattered across the map.

The path itself is a straight highway, going from one road tunnel into another.

took place on a one-lane highway. Several parts of the highway have seen severe damage. Some parts of it were supported by wooden planks, though vines were overgrown on these parts. Along the highway were lampposts. The highway crossed three islands, all of which were forested and, at parts, were mountainous. Two rivers separated the three islands, which the highway passed over on concrete bridges. The rivers were connected at both ends by the sea which surrounded all three islands. On the first island was a wooden hut that could be seen as well as a sewage system, which indicated some human habitation. On the second island, only trees could be seen. On the third island, a destroyed vehicle could be seen as well as a large advertisement billboard.

The highway path began and ended at two road tunnels on the islands.
